meta.reviewRule: dayIndex % 7 == 3 (every 7th day, a Sunday for the default start)
meta.notes: Difficulty labels follow LeetCode as of Oct 2026 and may change. URLs are built from titles; if one 404s, search the LC number. Importance scores (0-3) are a judgment-based synthesis, not official company data.

topics.name: Python, Big-O & Basic Logic
dailyFocus: Python for DSA: list/dict/set/deque/heapq, sorted(key=), slicing, reading stdin; Big-O basics (O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n^2))
Digit and loop logic; always dry-run on paper before coding

topics.name: Arrays & Matrix
dailyFocus: In-place array tricks: write pointer, swap, fill from the back
Kadane, prefix/suffix products, rotation by reversal, next permutation
Matrix traversal: spiral, rotate, set zeroes; first missing positive

topics.name: Strings
dailyFocus: String basics: palindromes, reverse, subsequence, two pointers on strings
Substring problems: expand around center; string building
Parsing and simulation: reverse words, multiply strings, compression, zigzag

topics.name: Hashing
dailyFocus: HashMap/HashSet basics: lookup, complement (Two Sum), duplicates
Frequency counting and anagrams (Counter, sorted key)
Hash + grouping and sequences: group anagrams, longest consecutive, sudoku sets
Design with hashing: O(1) structures, time-based map; hard: max points on a line

topics.name: Prefix Sum & Subarrays
dailyFocus: Prefix sum + hashmap trick: sum(i..j) = P[j] - P[i-1]; range queries
Remainder/balance tricks (divisible by K, 0/1 as -1/+1), difference array, 2D prefix

topics.name: Two Pointers
dailyFocus: Opposite-end pointers on sorted arrays (squares, parity, vowels, Two Sum II)
k-Sum family: sort + fix one + two pointers; skip duplicates; Dutch flag
Container with most water and trapping rain water: why moving the smaller side works

topics.name: Sliding Window
dailyFocus: Fixed-size window: running sum, set of last k
Variable window (expand right, shrink left): longest / shortest satisfying a condition
Window + hashmap: permutation, anagrams, replacement trick
At-most-K trick, windows with one deletion, minimum window substring

topics.name: Binary Search
dailyFocus: Classic template (lo/hi/mid), lower/upper bound, insert position, sqrt
Rotated sorted array, peak element, 2D matrix, single element in sorted array
Binary search on the ANSWER (Koko, ship capacity): monotonic feasibility check
Hard: partition-based median of two sorted arrays; split array largest sum

topics.name: Sorting & Intervals
dailyFocus: Sorting ideas (merge sort, quick sort), custom comparators, Python key=
Merge / insert intervals; sort by start vs by end
Greedy on intervals: non-overlapping, arrows; custom sort (largest number)

topics.name: Linked List
dailyFocus: Pointer basics: reverse list, merge two lists, dummy node
Fast and slow pointers: cycle, middle, cycle start
Remove nth from end, reorder list, add two numbers, find duplicate (Floyd)
Pointer surgery: copy random pointer, sort list (merge sort), reverse k-group

topics.name: Stack & Queue
dailyFocus: Stack basics: bracket matching, min stack, queue using stacks
Expression evaluation, car fleet, decode string
Monotonic stack: next greater element, daily temperatures, stock span
Monotonic stack / deque (hard): largest rectangle in histogram, sliding window maximum

topics.name: Recursion & Backtracking
dailyFocus: Recursion thinking: base case, recursion tree, call stack (Fibonacci, power of two)
Subsets and permutations template: choose / explore / un-choose
Combination sum family; handling duplicates by sorting and skipping
Grid and string backtracking: word search, palindrome partitioning, phone letters
Hard backtracking with pruning: N-Queens, Sudoku solver

topics.name: Trees & BST
dailyFocus: Binary tree basics: DFS recursion (depth, same tree, invert, symmetric)
Height-based recursion (diameter, balanced) + start of BFS level order
BFS variants (zigzag) + BST properties: validate BST, kth smallest
BST operations: LCA of BST, delete node, insert node
LCA of a binary tree, path sum II and III
Good nodes, construct tree from traversals, flatten to linked list
Hard trees: max path sum, serialize/deserialize, vertical order

topics.name: Heap / Priority Queue
dailyFocus: Heap basics (heapq): kth largest, K closest points, frequency sort
Heap + greedy / scheduling: task scheduler, reorganize string, kth in sorted matrix
Two heaps and K-way merge: median from data stream, merge k lists, design twitter

topics.name: Greedy
dailyFocus: Greedy choice property: assign cookies, jump game I and II
Gas station, partition labels, hand of straights
Valid parenthesis string, candy; proving greedy vs finding counter-examples

topics.name: Graphs: BFS / DFS & Grids
dailyFocus: Graph representation (adjacency list), DFS/BFS templates, visited set; flood fill, islands
Grid graphs: max area of island, multi-source BFS (rotting oranges), boundary DFS (surrounded regions)
Pacific-Atlantic, connected components (provinces), bipartite check
All paths in a DAG, clone graph (DFS with map)
Shortest path in an unweighted graph: binary matrix, Word Ladder

topics.name: Graphs: Topo Sort & Union-Find
dailyFocus: Topological sort: Kahn's algorithm (BFS) and DFS; Course Schedule I and II
Union-Find (DSU) with path compression: redundant connection, network connectivity
DSU applications: accounts merge, equality equations
Hard: longest increasing path (DFS + memo), largest component by common factor

topics.name: Graphs: Shortest Path & MST
dailyFocus: Dijkstra with a heap + K-stops variant (Bellman-Ford style): network delay, max probability, cheapest flights
Min effort path (Dijkstra on grid); MST with Kruskal/Prim: min cost to connect points
Hard: reconstruct itinerary (Euler path), swim in rising water

topics.name: Trie
dailyFocus: Trie insert / search / startsWith; replace words
Trie + DFS: add and search words (wildcard), Word Search II

topics.name: DP: 1D & Grid
dailyFocus: DP mindset: recursion, then memo, then table, then space optimisation (Fibonacci family)
Linear DP: house robber I and II, decode ways
Unbounded / coin DP: coin change, word break
Grid DP: unique paths, minimum path sum
Maximum product subarray (track max and min); hard: dungeon game

topics.name: DP: Knapsack & Subsequences
dailyFocus: 0/1 knapsack: partition equal subset sum, target sum, ones and zeroes
Unbounded knapsack: coin change II, combination sum IV (loop order matters)
LIS (O(n^2) then O(n log n)) and LCS
State-machine DP (stock with cooldown) + Russian doll envelopes
Hard DP: stock IV, maximum profit in job scheduling

topics.name: DP: Strings & Advanced
dailyFocus: Palindromic subsequence and repeated subarray (2D string DP)
Edit distance, interleaving string
Maximal square, minimum cost for tickets (grid / decision DP)
Hard: distinct subsequences, regular expression matching

topics.name: Bit Manipulation
dailyFocus: Bit basics: AND/OR/XOR, shifts, count set bits; single number with XOR
Harder bit tricks: add without +, single number II and III, divide two integers

topics.name: Math & Number Theory
dailyFocus: Digits and parity: palindrome number, happy number, plus one
Fast exponentiation, sieve of Eratosthenes, trailing zeroes

topics.name: Design (LRU, LFU)
dailyFocus: LRU cache (hash map + doubly linked list), circular queue
Browser history; LFU cache

statusMeaning.Attempted: Tried it, or read the solution but cannot yet code it from memory. Not counted.
statusMeaning.Solved: Can write it from scratch without looking (a hint during the first attempt is fine). Counted.
statusMeaning.Revised: Redone from scratch on a later day without help. Counted.

rules.title: Think first
rules.text: 25-30 minutes alone, then one hint, then the solution. Close the solution and code it from scratch the same day.

rules.title: Say it out loud
rules.text: State brute force, then the optimised idea, then time and space complexity before typing code.

rules.title: Name the pattern
rules.text: Write the pattern and its trigger words in the Mistake Log (e.g. 'sorted + pair' -> two pointers).

rules.title: Redo on schedule
rules.text: Anything that needed a hint or the solution gets redone at +1, +7 and +30 days.

rules.title: Carry over
rules.text: Unfinished problems roll to the next day. Never skip review days.

rules.title: DP in four steps
rules.text: Brute-force recursion, then memo, then table, then space optimisation.

rules.title: Dry-run on paper
rules.text: Tiny example plus edge cases: empty input, one element, duplicates.

rules.title: Plain editor sometimes
rules.text: Online assessments have no autocomplete; also practise stdin/stdout parsing (HackerRank style).

rules.title: One list only
rules.text: Do not switch problem sheets mid-way.

patternTriggers.trigger: sorted array + find a pair / triplet
longest / shortest subarray or substring with a condition
subarray sum equals / divisible by K
minimum X such that ... / maximum X that still works
top K / Kth largest / streaming median
count ways / min cost with overlapping subproblems
